external_evidence: Communications Biology 2025 s42003-025-08431-y ACC-MDT recurrent theta circuit
core_delta: Primary re-entry should be a bounded receiver-specific FeedbackInnovationPacket derived from predicted-vs-verified reality, uncertainty change, utility/residual change and causal-use receipts; previous model output is at most a weak decaying salience prior unless real tests justify more.
Keep epistemic innovation, goal/value utility and causal/provenance credit as distinct feedback dimensions rather than one reward scalar.
Treat re-entry injection strength as a stability variable with verification/provenance/calibration quality, habituation, staleness and instability shadows controlling effective gain.
Trigger expensive recurrence on material outcome/innovation/uncertainty/residual/risk/dependency events, then apply marginal-value continuation logic; do not recur on a global fixed cadence.
Use typed hysteresis/deadbands so event-triggering does not chatter while preserving a slow-drift detector to avoid missed accumulating error.
Reject wrong-epoch/stale/provenance-broken feedback rather than approximately applying it.

Preserve direct verified-outcome feedback as a serious simpler counterhypothesis because it beat innovation on continuous-state MAE in the synthetic stress test even though it used more feedback and saturated more.

synthetic_sanity_check.preserved_tradeoff: Direct verified-outcome feedback had lower continuous-state MAE in this constructed model, so innovation is not promoted as universally dominant.

clayresearch.delta: Extend the three-way baseline with a fourth mechanism axis: historical direct self-output feedback vs direct verified-outcome feedback vs verified innovation packets. Adjudicate on a Pareto metric vector, not accuracy alone.
clayresearch.required_next_test: Cross-domain A/B/C/D matrix including calibration, recovery, saturation, feedback cost and provenance sensitivity.

frank.delta: Preserve historical ModelOutput->Thalamus feedback as ancestry but test demotion to a weak decaying salience prior; make verified innovation the candidate primary re-entry signal.
frank.required_next_test: Map historical +0.15/-0.05 output bias and 0.87 decay into a matched H1 lesion/replacement experiment against innovation feedback.

gwt.delta: Workspace recurrence should reopen on material verified innovation/uncertainty/residual events rather than generic activity; packet lineage must survive selected->delivered->reconstructed->used->outcome->reentry.
gwt.required_next_test: Event-triggered GWT reopening vs fixed cadence vs activity-triggered reopening with truthful/shuffled/provenance-broken packets.

emergenz.delta: Treat provenance-sensitive innovation response as a causal-control readout, not an emergence score; test whether shuffled feedback preserves activity while destroying useful correction.
emergenz.required_next_test: Factorial provenance x feedback-law x lesion/rescue experiment with model output frozen where possible.

claycode.delta: Add executable typed representation for FeedbackInnovationPacket, verification/provenance quality, receiver-specific gain caps, validity window, hysteresis/deadband, rejection and rollback semantics without redesigning language unless current semantics fail.
claycode.required_next_test: Compile minimal packet creation->validation->route->reject/apply->receipt flow through current parser/type-effect/runtime on Ubuntu.

hyperposition.delta: Use large verified innovation with high residual as evidence for reopening alternatives; do not use model self-reference alone as an attractor-strength signal.
hyperposition.required_next_test: Wrong-attractor episodes comparing innovation-triggered branch reopening, output-echo reopening and no reopening.

claygraph.delta: Project predicted->verified->innovation->credit->receiver re-entry edges with gain/delay/validity/provenance, while keeping the graph derived and non-authoritative.
claygraph.required_next_test: Reconstruct causal packet paths across epochs and prove stale/shuffled packet edges cannot masquerade as valid closure.

unifieddb.delta: Persist immutable predicted/verified pairs plus typed innovation packets, packet validity/rejection reasons, provenance/credit receipts, applied gain and durable-learning admission identity for deterministic replay.
unifieddb.required_next_test: Out-of-order and duplicate outcome receipt replay proving exactly-once durable admission and fail-closed stale/wrong-epoch packet behavior.

harness.delta: Add feedback-law differential to H1: ORIGINAL direct self-output, perfected direct verified-outcome, perfected event-triggered innovation, then H2/H3 one-module innovation if supported.
harness.required_next_test: Frozen episodes + real outcome verification + provenance controls + gain/deadband sweeps + crash/restart; measure accuracy/calibration/recovery/saturation/cost/false credit.

global_controls: synthetic controller result is mechanism evidence only, not Frank runtime evidence
previous model output is not truth
verified outcome does not automatically identify causal credit
bad provenance must be rejectable and measurable
event-triggering needs a slow-drift safety path
different loop families may require different innovation types/timescales
direct verified-outcome feedback remains a live simpler counterhypothesis
